description: This PHP source file defines the 'CorporateBrandingController' class within the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component with various properties related to corporate branding customization such as image types, aspect ratios, and maximum file size. The class uses traits for configuration services and manages component properties before rendering.

classes.name: CorporateBrandingController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for preparing the Vue component for corporate branding settings in the HRM system. Sets up component properties related to image types, aspect ratios, and file size limits.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with necessary properties before rendering, including allowed image types, aspect ratios, aspect ratio tolerance, and maximum file size.
